text_block_list.text:
That day, heavy rain poured from the morning.
Though it stopped in the afternoon...

Due in part to track conditions,
all training sessions were canceled.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Shakur-san, how unusual.
For you to ask
to walk home together."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Doto, take a look at that river.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, a river...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-It's rushing so fast... It rained so much, it doesn't even look like the usual river...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The river... doesn't change. Even if it looks
different at a glance, nothin's really changed since yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What changed—was the volume of water.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Water's poured into a vessel that was already there.
It's got more momentum now, but it ain't gonna burst.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Those are—'numerical values'. The world of numbers, you see."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: H-Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Doto. What happens if more water
flows into a river than it can hold?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? U-Um, that's...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't really get it, but maybe...~
it'll overflow?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. Below the threshold, no change occurs,
but once the threshold is crossed, change is inevitable."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whether you cry or scream, water's gonna spill over.
That's just how it is.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-If it overflows, the residents will really
be in trouble, won't they? Everything would be
flooded and splashing with water.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Before that, we need to make the river bigger~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...It ain't gonna happen.
Not that easily."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Try to force it wider, and the river breaks.
Same goes if you try to gulp down all that water
without getting bigger first.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Initial values don't change so easily.
After all, they're the premise for everything.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In this world, there's a river of numbers constantly flowin'.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And—more often than not, events move
and settle just as the numbers dictate.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um... In other words~.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to understand. It's just that this year,
a lot of folks will probably witness that number firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, it's a familiar cliché,
but it makes me wanna puke...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we'll see what happens. It's fine if it's accepted.
But if they overreach without knowing their place—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—I'll break.
Both myself and those around me, most likely.
